items.source:
Create a new ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException for the given object,
with the default "optimistic locking failed" message.
items.translation: 为给定的对象创建一个新的 `ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException`，使用默认的“乐观锁失败”消息。

items.source: identifier - the ID of the object for which the locking failed

Create a new ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException for the given object,
with the given explicit message.
items.translation: 为给定的对象和给定的明确消息创建一个新的 ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException。

items.source: persistentClassName - the name of the persistent class

Exception thrown on an optimistic locking violation for a mapped object.
Provides information about the persistent class and the identifier.
items.translation: 在映射对象上因乐观锁冲突而抛出异常。提供有关持久化类和标识符的信息。

items.source:
Create a general ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException with the given message,
without any information on the affected object.
items.translation: 创建一个通用的 `ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException`，并附带给定的消息，但不包含有关受影响对象的信息。

items.source: Return the identifier of the object for which the locking failed.
items.translation: 返回锁定失败的对象的标识符。

items.source:
Return the persistent class of the object for which the locking failed.
If no Class was specified, this method returns null.
items.translation: 返回锁定失败的对象所属的持久化类。如果未指定任何类，此方法将返回 null。

items.source:
Return the name of the persistent class of the object for which the locking failed.
Will work for both Class objects and String names.
items.translation:
返回锁定失败的对象所属的持久化类的名称。
此方法适用于 Class 对象和 String 名称。

items.source: Return the persistent class of the object for which the locking failed.
items.translation: 返回锁定失败的对象所属的持久化类。

items.source: Return the name of the persistent class of the object for which the locking failed.
items.translation: 返回锁定失败的对象所属的持久化类的名称。
